Primary Ability: Dexterity

Quantum-phase messenger who slips between timelines to deliver hope.

  • Tier 1: Proficiency in Stealth & Acrobatics. Ignore first terrain hazard each turn.
  • Tier 2: When completing an Infiltration scenario, refund 1 Intrigue OP.
  • Tier 3: Evasion feature (half damage on failed Dex saves).
  • Tier 4: Once per turn, teleport 30 ft as a bonus action (dimensional flicker).
